_help: The Operations home in admin (js/admin-ops.js). queues: the cards, in the order used when two are equally urgent; open is the admin tab it opens. hours: the colour limits (green under amber, amber under red, red above). todo: your setup list. check says how it is ticked automatically: sql-NNN (the SQL file has been run), fn:NAME:VERSION (that Edge Function is deployed and up to date), razorpay-live, resend, social, books, portraits, audience, review, business-live; manual ones you tick yourself. digest: the daily email (sent by the ops-digest function at 9:00 India time).
